audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the Community Center confrontation event. All thirteen player-facing lines were translated with canonical Joja and JojaMart terminology and character-name inflection. Event commands, actors, coordinates, frames, timings, music, sound and sprite IDs, percentages, placeholders, emotes, quoted-string boundaries, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
